evidence: We used TMAl and ASH, as the gas sources for Al and As atoms. The total flow rate of carrier gas was 2000 seem. The mole fraction of TMAl molecules was typically 2 X 10e6 and that of ASH, was 2 X lo-“. The TMAl and ASH, source gases were supplied alternatingly by a jet nozzle with a pressure-balanced vent-and-run manifold. Alternating gas pulses were separated by a hydrogen purge pulse (3 s duration) which prevented the reactants from mixing.
